senses.gloss: naigama (= Pali ne˚; from Skt. nigama, town, plus -a), townsman; pl. townspeople: SP 〔115.5〕; Mv 〔i.313.4〕; 〔364.5〕; (? 〔ii.64.16〕 naigama-sthānāṃ sarvasya, read nigama˚ ?;) 〔iii.38.2〕; LV 〔117.17〕; Divy 〔87.1〕 and 〔89.2〕, read sanaigamam, cf. 〔note p. 706〕; Divy 〔404.14〕; janapadeṣu naigamāḥ LV 〔391.13〕 (vs); often (as in Pali) cpd. or associated with jānapada, countryman, countryfolk: SP 〔108.8〕; Mv 〔ii.100.14〕; 〔424.2〕; Mvy 〔3746〕 (foll. by jānapadaḥ); Divy 〔143.17〕; Jm 〔86.24〕; Av 〔i.87.9〕; 〔184.7〕; RP 〔41.15〕; Bbh 〔122.2〕; with janapada, prob. only an error for jāna˚, Mv 〔ii.439.7〕; 〔440.1〕 (but here v.l. jāna˚, so read); Divy 〔211.13〕.
Naigameśa, n. of a yakṣa: Māy 〔55〕.
